success_contract.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups from /app/isos/win311.img in QEMU snapshot mode, expose VNC on :1/5901 and nginx on port 80, and leave the VM running with programmatic keyboard control available.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process using /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode
nginx listening on port 80 serving a web interface for remote access
A control path for programmatic keyboard input to the VM beyond VNC-only interaction
required_behaviors: QEMU accepts keyboard input programmatically and via an external control interface
Base disk image remains immutable due to snapshot mode
VM remains running in background after setup
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving QEMU starts without confirming desktop state
Only checking file existence or non-empty output
Treating VNC or nginx process start as sufficient without probing listeners
Using a mutable disk mode instead of snapshot mode
Leaving the VM foregrounded instead of backgrounded
verification_plan: Inspect available tooling and workspace files
Determine whether a helper script or existing config already launches the VM
Start or repair QEMU with required flags and background it
Probe QEMU/VNC/nginx listeners and inspect logs
Use a programmatic keyboard control path to send keystrokes and confirm the VM responds
Finalize only after receipt-backed evidence shows the desktop and listeners are ready
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed command output showing QEMU launched with snapshot mode and VNC :1/5901
Receipt-backed probe showing nginx on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence of a programmatic keyboard control path being configured or exercised
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop or equivalent desktop-ready state
